narrative.overview:
Lista de Compras is a one-hand shopping list on warm paper. The counter is the whole picture: a deep-moss plate across the top, then a narrow column where a name, a quantity, and a terracotta add action keep each line in this browser. Rows sit far enough apart for a thumb; inside a badge the type is large and the stepper is tall. The browser mark repeats the same three tones: a deep-moss square, Areia bars, and one Terracota dot.

Color works by proportion. Areia is the ground, Areia Suave is every surface you write on, and Grafite is what you read. Moss builds the plate, the steppers, the labels, and the selection. Terracota stays scarce. The pinned brief limited it to Adicionar; the shipped list also uses it for the focus ring, the text caret, and the error wash.

Type has two jobs. Bricolage Grotesque carries the title. Atkinson Hyperlegible carries the list, the fields, and the controls, at 400 for reading and 700 for names, labels, and actions. Changes ease out on a quick curve; when motion is reduced they collapse to a near-instant fade.
keyCharacteristics: Full-width deep-moss plate over a centered column capped at 34rem
Areia ground, Areia Suave fields and badges, Grafite text
Terracota limited to Adicionar, focus, the caret, and the error wash
A vertical moss stepper on the right of each badge, with 1.75rem between badges
Bricolage Grotesque for the title, Atkinson Hyperlegible for everything else
Soft moss-tinted shadows under Adicionar and each badge

rules.name: The Terracotta Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Terracota fills Adicionar, draws the 2px focus ring, colors the caret, and tints the error wash. It stays off the plate, the badges, the labels, and the item names.

rules.name: The Moss Structure Rule
rules.body: Moss and deep moss are the structure: the plate, the steppers, the field labels, placeholder text, selection, and the scrollbar.

rules.name: The One Display Face Rule
rules.body: Bricolage Grotesque is used for the page title only. Every other line is Atkinson Hyperlegible.

rules.name: The Narrow Column Rule
rules.body: The plate is full width. Under it, the list sits in one centered column at min(34rem, 100%), with 1.25rem of side inset.

rules.name: The Thumb Gap Rule
rules.body: Item badges stack in a single column with 1.75rem between them.

rules.name: The Soft Moss Shadow Rule
rules.body: Resting depth is a change of tone: Areia, then Areia Suave, then moss. The only shadows are soft and tinted with deep moss: a drop under each badge and a short lift under Adicionar.

rules.name: The Shared Soft Corner Rule
rules.body: Outer shells use a 0.9rem field corner, a 0.95rem corner on Adicionar and the stepper, and a 1.15rem badge corner. Stepper buttons (0.7rem) and the error wash (0.75rem) stay inside that same soft family.

rules.name: The Vertical Count Rule
rules.body: Quantity is a vertical stepper: plus above the number, minus below. On a badge it sits on the right; beside Adicionar it sits on the left.

dos: Do keep the page on Areia (#f5f2eb) and put fields and item badges on Areia Suave (#e8e2d5).
Do set the page title in Bricolage Grotesque at weight 600, and every other line in Atkinson Hyperlegible.
Do keep quantity in a vertical moss stepper: plus above the number, minus below.
Do reserve Terracota for Adicionar, the 2px focus ring, the text caret, and the error wash.
Do keep the working column at min(34rem, 100%) under a full-width deep-moss plate.
donts: Don't lay the list out as a card grid or a dashboard.
Don't paint the plate, badges, labels, or item names with Terracota.
Don't add a second display face or set the title in a system sans.
Don't use a hard offset shadow.
Don't place plus and minus side by side.
Don't set labels in tracked uppercase, and don't put an eyebrow above the title.
